author: Antonialock
body: Ahh, what do you think wrt annotation of scpx? The authors of 15145982 say (I think they lost part of fig6): "Sixty five percent of AeSCP-x labeling was in the peroxisome (Fig. 5). There was some AeSCP-x labeling in the cytosol, mitochondria, and nucleus in the midgut epithelium (Figs. 5, 6). Because the anti-AeSCP-x antibodies were made against the SCP-2 domain of AeSCPx, the results indicate that AeSCP-x and the proteolytic product, AeSCP-xC (the cleaved SCP-domain of AeSCP-x), localize mostly to peroxisomes (Fig. 6B)."

author: hattrill
body: @Antonialock from the gold labelling it is very difficult to assess whether that is genuine mitochondrial labelling for the AeSCP-x product, it's quite sporadic. I would side with the AeSCP-x in peroxisome and cytosol and AeSCP-2 in the cytosol.
